description: Enable an image tag for an application so Gameye preloads it across its infrastructure; re-enabling an existing tag pulls it forward. Use this when a registry webhook did not register the tag. The server checks the regions:read scope. Pass dryRun=true to preview the request.

dryRun.description: Return the exact request that would be sent, with the API token masked, and send nothing

name: gameye_enable_tag
title: Enable image tag
